snippet.title: Obey the Insect God - Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo is now available on Steam for the game Obey the Insect God!

Obey the Insect God is a 2D narrative driven action game featuring 90s style FMV digitized sprites.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4109630/Obey_the_Insect_God/
